Always use mobile data (4G/5G), even if the phone is on Wi-Fi

Fast Hotspot

Wi-Fi name: %1$s
Password: %2$s

Then set the proxy on this Wi-Fi network:
• Automatic (recommended): %5$s
• Or manual: server %3$s, port %4$d

Windows: Settings → Network → Proxy → "Use setup script".
Mac: Wi-Fi → Details → Proxies → "Automatic proxy configuration". Note: on a Mac this applies to ALL Wi-Fi networks — turn it off afterwards, or create a separate network Location for Fast Hotspot.
iPhone/iPad: Wi-Fi → (i) → Configure Proxy → Automatic.
Android: Wi-Fi → network → Edit → Advanced → Proxy → "Proxy Auto-Config".
Fast Hotspot needs the Nearby devices / Location permission to create the Wi-Fi network.
Turn Wi-Fi on first. You don\'t need to connect to any network — Wi-Fi just has to be switched on. Also turn off the phone\'s built-in hotspot.
On this Android version, Location must be switched on to create a Wi-Fi Direct network.

Why the normal hotspot is slow: many carriers detect tethered traffic and slow it down (or limit it to a small hotspot allowance), even though the phone itself gets full 4G/5G speed.

What Fast Hotspot does: it creates its own Wi-Fi network and runs a proxy on the phone. Devices that use the proxy have their web traffic sent out by the phone itself, so it goes over the phone's normal mobile-data connection.

Setup on each device:
1. Join the Wi-Fi network shown in the app.
2. Set that Wi-Fi's proxy to the Auto address (PAC) shown, or enter the server and port manually.

Tips:
• Pick 5 GHz for the best speed (if a device can't see the network, try 2.4 GHz).
• Keep the phone plugged in for long sessions.
• If Android asks, exclude Fast Hotspot from battery optimisation.
• Turn off the phone's built-in hotspot first.
• If the band shows 2.4 GHz, turn off Bluetooth on the phone and laptop: it shares the 2.4 GHz radio and can cut Wi-Fi speed a lot.
• Disconnect the phone from other Wi-Fi networks (keep Wi-Fi switched on) so the hotspot can use 5 GHz.
• Mac: proxy settings apply to every Wi-Fi network. Use a separate network Location for Fast Hotspot.

Limitations: only apps that respect the system proxy are covered (browsers, most apps, streaming, downloads). Some games, VPNs and UDP-based apps (like some video calls) may not work through a proxy.

Check your mobile plan's terms: some plans don't allow using phone data on other devices beyond the hotspot allowance.
